import click
from click.testing import CliRunner

@click.command()
def cmd():
    click.echo('test')

runner = CliRunner(capture='fd')  # Use capture='fd' to get real file descriptors
result = runner.invoke(cmd)
# In 8.4.0, default capture mode no longer exposes original fd
assert result.exit_code == 0
before_snippet:
import click
from click.testing import CliRunner
import os

@click.command()
def cmd():
    click.echo('test')

runner = CliRunner()
result = runner.invoke(cmd)
# In 8.3.3, fileno() on the redirected stream returned the original fd
assert result.output_bytes is not None or os.isatty(result.stdout.fileno() if hasattr(result, 'stdout') else 1)
title: CliRunner fileno() no longer exposes original file descriptor in default capture mode
